note: Deadline-edition pre-registration. Companion to predictions.json (frozen 2026-07-04). These calls are made 8 days before the August 3 deadline and are graded after the season by the same rules: the grade is the grade.

mead_bat.grading: FanGraphs wOBA, BOS only, season end

contreras_fade.claim: Contreras's second-half OPS finishes at least 40 points below his first-half mark

gray_fade.claim: Gray's second-half ERA exceeds his first-half 2.78
